화·수·목·금·토요일, 이 이름이 오행이에요.

일요일과 월요일은 해와 달, 나머지 다섯 요일은 오행 이름을 딴 다섯 행성에서 왔어요. 그리고 오행은 "원소"가 아니라 "움직임"이에요. 행(行)은 다니고 움직인다는 뜻이거든요. 상생의 순서는 봄·여름·환절기·가을·겨울, 계절이 도는 순서와 같아요.

몰랐던 오행 이야기와 상생·상극을 한 번에 정리했어요. 저장해 두고 보세요.

· English ·
In Korean, the days from Tuesday through Saturday are named for the five elements: Tuesday is Fire, Wednesday Water, Thursday Wood, Friday Metal and Saturday Earth.

Sunday and Monday take their names from the sun and moon. The other five days take theirs from the five planets, which are named after the elements. The five elements are less "elements" than "movements," since the character 行 means to go or to move. The order in which they feed one another follows the turning seasons: spring, summer, the turn between seasons, fall and winter.

This post gathers little-known facts about the five elements and how they feed and check one another. Save it for later.
